user_query: I want to plan a surprise party for my friend's promotion, including sending a congratulatory message, checking if his phone number is blacklisted, and confirming the current time.

TaskList.description: Retrieve celebratory messages from the Messages tool to select an appropriate congratulatory message.
Check if the friend's phone number is in the SMSAPI.com blacklist.
If the phone number is blacklisted, obtain an alternative sender name from SMSAPI.com.
Get the current time to coordinate the surprise event.
